_notes: Validation config: mouse tracksets CM/FB plus human tracksets CMh/FBh (organism 0 = human output heads applied to the mouse sequence), for comparing native predictions with measured snATAC. Used by 'submit_all.sh validate'. Human sets cost an extra forward pass per sequence.
weights: pretrained AlphaGenome weights. A .safetensors/.pth/.pt file is accepted. CHECK this path on Katana.

tracksets: {name: {head: regex}}; head = atac | dnase | rna_seq | cage. Regex (case-insensitive) is searched in 'biosample_name | ontology_curie | track_name | assay_title | life_stage | strand | biosample_type' of the MOUSE tracks; matches are averaged. Optional extras (more heads = slower): CM dnase '^heart [|].*adult', CM cage 'cardiac muscle cell', FB dnase 'fibroblast of lung', FB cage '^fibroblast [|]'.

perturb.reps: replicates per stochastic edit kind (shuffle 10, random/dinuc/flank 5). Optional perturb.reps_width {motif|170|peak: max reps} caps replicates per edit width (empty = no cap). Passes per site = 1 native + sum over conditions (00_check_env prints it).
